gold_points: Reserve revisions alter future DD&A rate; upward revisions raise earnings, downward lower them
DD&A of proved properties uses the unit-of-production method
Leasehold and proved property acquisition costs use proved developed plus proved undeveloped reserves
Lease and well equipment costs use only proved developed reserves
output.note: Answerable from the first chunk alone; the second chunk only repeats the proved developed reserves sentence before moving to impairments.
output.question: In EOG Resources' fiscal 2024 10-K, how do changes in estimated proved reserves affect the company's depreciation, depletion and amortization expense, and which reserve bases are used for different types of capitalized costs?
